rationale: The sole implementation delta sets `fn = NULL` after `fib6_add_1` returns an error pointer, preventing the later error-cleanup logic from treating the error pointer as a distinct node and dereferencing `pn`. The Logic section does not describe this normalization, any pointer-validity guard, or the vulnerable erroneous cleanup path.
